label: Figure 11.17: Long-run equilibrium in monopolistic competition
alt: The downward-sloping D = AR curve is tangent to AC at output q, where MR = MC, so price P equals cost per unit C and only normal profit is earned.
caption: In the long run entry and exit shift each firm’s demand until the AR curve is just tangent to AC. The firm produces at q where MC = MR, and at q the price P equals the average cost C, so there is no abnormal profit rectangle and no incentive to enter or leave. The tangency lies to the left of the minimum of AC.
